_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A task moves to another machine from where it runs, and back. The server runs in workspace mode, with the project "Mover tasks" and its task {{TASK}}, whose first message is "Hello". "The place" is the element with data-testid "conversation-place" in ".header"; its accessible name is its aria-label. "The dialog" is the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name contains "Move task to". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{TASK}}. 2. The place's aria-label should come to start with "This host". 3. An element whose text is exactly "Hello" should be visible. 4. There should come to be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "agent-thinking". 5. Click the place. 6. Click the element with data-testid "conversation-place-move". 7. Click the dialog's text "An existing machine". 8. If the dialog has a select "#machine-via", select its option with the value "" (no integration). 9. Fill the dialog's field labelled "SSH destination" with "nobody@shelley-e2e.invalid". 10. Fill its field labelled "Directory" with "/tmp". 11. Click its element with data-testid "machine-save". 12. There should come to be exactly 0 dialogs. 13. The place's aria-label should come to start with "Shared VM nobody@shelley-e2e.invalid". 14. The last element with data-testid "message-cwdchange" should contain "nobody@shelley-e2e.invalid" (the agent is told, as a status line). 15. Click the place. 16. Click the element with data-testid "conversation-place-move". 17. Click the dialog's text "This Shelley host". 18. Click its element with data-testid "machine-save". 19. There should come to be exactly 0 dialogs. 20. The place's aria-label should come to start with "This host".
